request: Fuzzy matching returns the same highlight positions for a pattern and target whether the scratch slab is fresh or was used by earlier matches: positions never depend on data a previous match left behind.

defects.description: Published bug fixed upstream: Fix nondeterministic highlight positions in FuzzyMatchV2 backtrace

trigger.input:
printf %s '' | base64 -d > src/algo/algo_test.go
if go test -count=1 -run '^(TestResultPositionsWithReusedSlab)$' ./src/algo >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo probe: pass; else echo probe: fail; fi

defects.why_missed: The project's own suite at the parent commit never exercised this input; the fix commit added the test that does.
